1.title: Chair Murkowski and Vice Chair Schatz deliver opening remarks during NAHASDA Business Meeting
1.description: U.S. Senator Lisa Murkowski (R-Alaska), Chairman of the Senate Committee on Indian Affairs, and U.S. Senator Brian Schatz (D-Hawaiʻi), Vice Chairman, delivered opening remarks during a business meeting where the committee advanced the bipartisan Native American Housing Assistance and Self-Determination (NAHASDA) Modernization Act of 2026 (S. 5354).

2.title: Chairman Murkowski Delivers Opening Remarks at NAHASDA Hearing
2.description: U.S. Senator Lisa Murkowski, Chairman of the Senate Committee on Indian Affairs, delivers an opening statement during a hearing titled, Oversight Hearing entitled, “Examining Housing Needs in Native Communities,” and Legislative Hearing to receive testimony on S. 5354, the Native American Housing Assistance and Self-Determination Modernization Act of 2026.

3.title: Murkowski Highlights Decade of Work Behind Native Children’s Commission Implementation Act
3.description: U.S. Senator Lisa Murkowski (R-Alaska), Chairman of the Senate Committee on Indian Affairs, spoke on the U.S. Senate floor regarding the Native Children’s Commission Implementation Act (S.4976), a comprehensive bill package she recently introduced alongside U.S. Senator Brian Schatz (D-Hawai’i), Vice Chairman of the Committee.

4.title: Murkowski & Schatz deliver opening remarks at hearing on five Indian waters rights settlements bills
4.description: U.S. Senator Lisa Murkowski (R-Alaska), Chairman of the Senate Committee on Indian Affairs, and U.S. Senator Brian Schatz (D-Hawaiʻi), Vice Chairman, deliver opening statements during a legislative hearing to examine the following five bills related to Indian water rights settlements.

5.title: Chairman Murkowski Speaks on the Impacts of Typhoon Halong
5.description: U.S. Senator Lisa Murkowski (R-Alaska), Chairman of the Senate Committee on Indian Affairs, delivered a speech on the Senate Floor to discuss the impacts of ex-Typhoon Halong which displaced more than 1,000 Alaskans and devastated communities along the coast of Western Alaska. Having heard firsthand from Alaskans impacted by the storm, the Senator discussed ongoing recovery efforts, challenges with the potential relocation of villages, and the need to strengthen federal mitigation and recovery programs.

6.title: Chair Murkowski, Vice Chair Schatz speak during hearing on Indian water rights settlements
6.description: U.S. Senator Lisa Murkowski (R-Alaska), Chairman of the Senate Committee on Indian Affairs, and U.S. Senator Brian Schatz (D-Hawaiʻi), Vice Chairman, deliver opening statements for an oversight hearing titled, “Examining Federal Policies Governing Indian Water Rights Settlements,” and Legislative Hearing to receive testimony on S. 953, Northeastern Arizona Indian Water Rights Settlement Act of 2025

8.title: Senator Murkowski Honors Orange Shirt Day
